mcat_name_audit.reason: The term 'Bunkhouses' is the primary trade keyword confirmed across Agent 3 alt_names and market_context, and is the standard B2B search term used by Indian construction and infrastructure buyers for portable worker accommodation cabins.

reason: The thumbnail shows colourful timber-framed recreational/holiday cabins in a landscaped outdoor setting — these are leisure accommodation structures, not the MS/steel-framed prefabricated portable worker accommodation cabins that define the primary segment.

The image actively misrepresents the MCAT: no steel frame, no sandwich panel construction, no industrial/construction site context — a buyer searching for portable labour accommodation cabins would not recognise this as relevant.

mcat_image_suggestions.prompt_for_generation: A portable prefabricated mild steel (MS) framed bunkhouse cabin for worker accommodation, rectangular box-shaped structure with corrugated metal or PUF sandwich panel walls in grey or off-white, single entry door with small window, placed on a flat construction site with bare ground, front-facing three-quarter view, clean white or light grey background, bright even studio lighting, product photography style, no people, no text overlays.
